meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Maximum-saturation research orchestration: ALWAYS proposes the final materials first (PDF+DOCX default), then parallel explore+librarian swarms across codebase, web, official docs, and OSS repos — max-roster teammode when the harness has it — with live journaling, a recursive EXPAND loop driven by leads workers return in message text, empirical verification by running code, and a cited synthesis with charts/Mermaid/assets behind a mandatory visual-QA gate. ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user demand for research — the word 'ulw-research' ('/ulw-research', '$ulw-research'), any 'ulw' research wording, 'ultradebate' or 'hyperdebate' research requests, or an explicit request for research / deep research / an ultra-precise investigation, in any language. Never self-activates for ordinary questions, debugging, or implementation context-gathering. While active it overrides exploration-bounding defaults: exhaustive coverage is the goal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发起深度研究,并联探索多源资料并输出带引证结论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要快速获取跨多源、带验证的深度研究报告
copy.tagline_en: Kick off deep research, explore multiple sources in parallel and deliver cited findings
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need fast, multi-source, verified deep-dive reports

howto.what: 你把研究任务交给 Claude，它会先约定最终报告格式（默认 PDF 和 Word），再同时派出多路搜索代理查代码、网页、官方文档等；全程记录日志、追查线索，用跑代码验证有争议说法，最终给出每条带出处、含图表的报告。
howto.when: 只有当你明确提出研究需求时才触发，例如说出‘ulw-research’、‘ultradebate’等词，或用任何语言要求做深度研究、超精确调查；普通提问、调试、收集背景信息不会触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-research 帮我深度研究一下 RAG 技术的最新进展。
say.note: 会先给出报告格式，再并行派出多路搜索代理。

say.text: 研究 PostgreSQL 和 MySQL 的并发写入对比，所有结论都要有出处。
say.note: 会跑代码验证性能争议，产出每条带出处的报告。

say.text: hyperdebate 调查‘小模型能否替代大模型做代码生成’，两边证据都要查。
say.note: 会安排至少两路对立视角，对每个争议点做完整攻防。

howto.what_en: When handed a research task, Claude agrees the final format (PDF/DOCX by default), spawns parallel search agents across code/web/docs/repos, journals live, chases leads, verifies claims by running code, outputs a cited report with charts.
howto.when_en: Triggers only on explicit research requests: 'ulw-research', 'ultradebate', or deep-research / ultra-precise investigation requests. Not for ordinary questions, debugging, or context-gathering.

say_en.text: Use ulw-research to deeply research the latest RAG advancements.
say_en.note: Agrees on format first, then spawns parallel search agents.

say_en.text: Research PostgreSQL vs MySQL concurrent writes; every claim needs a source.
say_en.note: It verifies contested performance claims by running code.

say_en.text: Hyperdebate: small vs large models for code generation? Check both sides.
say_en.note: Two opposing perspectives debate each contested claim fully.
